sender.en: An “overseas employment agent” or travel agency, often on Facebook or WhatsApp

name.en: Fake job abroad: “guaranteed work visa for Saudi, Dubai, UK or Europe, pay the fee first”

how.en: An agent or agency promises a job and work visa in Saudi Arabia, Dubai, the UK or Europe, often with a high salary. You pay hundreds of thousands, sometimes millions, of rupees for the visa, ticket and “processing”. Then the documents never come, or turn out to be fake, and the agent stops answering or disappears. The FIA has arrested many such agents and urges people to check agents against its official list.

text.en: An agent offers a guaranteed job and visa abroad with a big salary.
You must pay a large fee up front for the visa, ticket or processing.
They push you to pay quickly before the “quota” closes.
No real documents arrive and the agent disappears.
Saudi Arabia driver jobs, salary 1,50,000 per month, visa + ticket guaranteed in 30 days. Limited seats! Send CNIC and passport copy and pay Rs 2,00,000 processing fee to confirm your seat.
UK work permit available urgently, care worker job, no IELTS required. Advance payment required for visa file. Contact on WhatsApp: [number]

fake visa documents from travel agent
A “guaranteed” visa or job, especially without interviews or IELTS.
Large payments in cash or to a personal account before any documents.
An agent not on the official list of licensed promoters.
Check the agent against the FIA’s official list before paying.
Never pay in cash or to personal accounts; keep receipts.
If cheated, file a complaint with the FIA or NCCIA.
